_comment: Describes this standalone build for ../lesson-app-tools/. Wired to the platform shell since 2026-09-18 by wire-platform.py, NOT the shared wire-progress.py / wire-platform-controls.py G1-4 use - this build has no deck, no finish(), no .dots nav, so those two refuse outright. Progress here means 'section reached': an IntersectionObserver over each lesson's <section class="step"> blocks, unit.completed firing once every section has been seen - the closest honest equivalent to G1-4's last finish() on a page with no check to pass. See check-platform-wiring.py. index.html is a real hub of six cards, generated with the lesson pages by split-into-lessons.py; squares-and-steps.html is that generator's INPUT and is deliberately not listed here, so it is not shipped.
